context_separation: Same independent /root/astra_cold_7e82fcf reviewer across all critic lanes, separate from implementation/design author /root/sol_world_interaction. Cold observations were frozen before the warm intent packet, with the limited inherited context and premature ending-scope clarification disclosed in COLD-REPORT.md. This is informed design-only repair review, not a new cold pass. Reviewer rejected proposal 01, accepted proposal 02 for incorporation, inspected the canonical diff and unchanged-step equality, and independently ran the structure gate for this digest. Reviewer did not edit the canonical design or implementation. All original cold/warm findings and both proposal reviews remain preserved.

progression.reason: The bounded nine-step journey retains entry, a shared lantern/loss motivation, separate direct-control practice, an unassessed growing-input demonstration, source inspection, next-input prediction, source inference, a changed communication case and local reply. The revised route loop uses one explicit device insertion/commit, then preserves the two distinct conceptual commitments before one unassessed continuation and deliberate Speak. Untimed prefix review and paused reload make that continuation inspectable without mandatory per-word clerical actions. Seven other steps are unchanged from the baseline, and the changed fields do not reorder their prerequisites.
progression.counterexample: Generating a route-revealing word before source inference would leak that decision; the sequence-practice pause and context-practice assessment boundary prohibit it. Running or waiting cannot commit either prediction. Reload during Open the must restore a paused saved prefix, require deliberate resumption and never duplicate an acknowledged word command. A successful first route need not demonstrate failure diagnosis, so completion is not evidence of that capability. No Level 2 is approved.

concept_fidelity.reason: The design keeps the narrow authored-word-toy limitation and the distinction between original request, supplied source and full generated history. Source support, prepared continuation and world task success remain separate: an old Moon source supports Moon while its route fails; the parade identifies no gate even if the toy emits Moon. Changed-problem still separates a person's current source from a newer unrelated note, and requires complete Meet at history. Phase-aware reveal boundaries prevent the completeness repair from supplying an uncommitted next-input answer.
concept_fidelity.counterexample: A parade/no-gate inference remains source-consistent even when the toy writes Moon; an inferred gate cannot change generation. Tavi's Sun Court note gives no Mira location despite naming a place and having the newest timestamp. A real model may reject unsuitable context or continue differently. The normal-play token caveat must remain available, and the tutorial must retain every request/source/prefix member rather than shed the request as cold A13 did.

decision_necessity.reason: Inspect, reversible stage, explicit source insertion/commit, reversible inference selection and explicit inference commitment have distinct semantics. A device without a pending source cannot guess one. The first source, input-rule and inference choices, assistance and actual output remain separate and immutable through retry. Precommit framing exposes the same route features equally; interpreted source-to-route traces appear only after source-inference commitment. These decisions survive the reduction of routine open/place/confirm/reopen and per-word Generate/Check actions.
decision_necessity.counterexample: Stage A, inspect B, return and insert must commit A; only explicitly staging B changes the pending source. Obscuring source words must leave no source-specific inference answer in the camera or highlight treatment. Keyboard focus and playback controls cannot commit an answer. Longest-option or fixed-position guessing remains possible in the bounded input choices; success does not establish broad mastery, and the changed-case shortcut probes remain necessary.

attention_and_access.reason: The revised encounter locates readable boards, pending-source identity, machine input and actual gate consequence in a neutral route-junction relationship. Equivalent semantic focus supplies the same observable facts without precision camera, dragging or mandatory travel. Phone/keyboard target and enlargement requirements remain explicit. Every postcommit prefix has stable untimed full-input history; entering inspection/history or leaving the device pauses playback, activating Run/Resume does not cancel itself, and reload starts paused. Required input members cannot be independently shed to fit optional framing.
attention_and_access.counterexample: At 200% phone text pause after Open the, inspect earlier and current request/source/history, turn away, return and reload: all prefixes must remain inspectable without duplicated commands or hidden required text. At 360px, a carrier that exists while clipping its request fails. A large questionnaire with an anchor remains a runtime failure even if every field is accessible. The player must be able to explain the board/route/device relationship; forcing walking cannot substitute for that relationship. The unchanged receiver and the opening's emotional staging still require whole-chapter runtime judgment.

research_application.reason: The design applies the existing research adaptations through preserved pre-feedback decisions and object-related causes/consequences. The updated situated-attention probe tests cue leakage, the player's explanation of the world relation, complete input under enlarged-text interruption/reload, and meaningful decisions versus clerical actions. This is a bounded revision of existing objects and encounters, not a genre or scale imitation. Judgment concerns the application of the recorded research observations, not a new external-media verification.
research_application.counterexample: A camera that translates a source into its answer would bypass reasoning even if attractive. A shorter button chain can remain a questionnaire over scenery; actual play must test what the world contributed. Waiting through an authored continuation is allowed only as unassessed presentation and cannot become independent learning evidence. Shared semantic-group, pre/postcommit emphasis and stable-history capabilities should be verified with a materially different fixture rather than hard-coded Moon/Star or four-word assumptions.

runtime_alignment.reason: No revised interaction runtime was played in this design review. Candidate 7e82fcf's original cold/warm needs_revision verdict and evidence gaps remain unchanged. Later targeted GUI work is informed repair verification, not a replacement cold pass. Implementation must preserve existing versioned snapshots, IDs, first-choice evidence and replay interpretation. Exact-candidate native alignment, presentation completeness, critic/release gates and final user acceptance remain separate. Motion/audio remain deferred and unassessed. This approval authorizes the bounded existing-chapter design for implementation, not deployment, Level 2 or readiness.
